exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  B Connor Macleod
  2  A The 16th century
  3  C Ramirez
  4  C the Kurgan
  5  A The Quickening


FILM HAQIDA QISQAChA:

  'Highlander' (1986) — fantastik film.

  Konnor Makleod — Shotlandiya tog'larida
  1518-yilda tug'ilgan. U jangda o'lishi
  kerak edi, lekin tirilib qoladi: u —
  O'LMAS (an immortal).

  Ramirez unga qilich bilan jang qilishni
  o'rgatadi. O'lmaslar orasida jang
  boradi — g'olib bittasi qoladi.

  Film ikki davrda parallel boradi:
  16-ASR Shotlandiyasi va 20-ASR Nyu-Yorki.

  ⚠ Aynan shuning uchun kitob bu filmni
  Unit 9 ga ('Times Change...' — o'tmish
  va hozir) tavsiya qilgan!


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  'What's the Highlander's name?'
    → CONNOR MACLEOD

    ⚠ 'Mac-' — Shotlandiya familiyalarining
    tipik boshlanishi ('o'g'li' degani):
       MacLeod, MacDonald, MacArthur

    Chalg'ituvchi variantlar ham
    shotlandcha ko'rinadi:
       'Charlie McDonald' (Mc- ham bor)
       'Kianu McCartney' (McCartney —
        haqiqiy familiya, lekin bu film
        emas)

 2  'When was the Highlander born?'
    → THE 16TH CENTURY

    Konnor 1518-yilda tug'ilgan — bu
    16-asr.

    ⚠ 'The 6th century' — juda erta
    (500-yillar).
    ⚠ 'The 20th century' — filmning
    IKKINChI davri, lekin u o'shanda
    tug'ilmagan.

 3  'Who is the Highlander's teacher?'
    → RAMIREZ

    Ramirez — Konnorni o'rgatadigan
    qadimiy o'lmas.

    ⚠ 'Rodriquez' va 'Gonzales' —
    o'xshash ispancha familiyalar
    (chalg'ituvchi variantlar).

 4  'What's the Black Knight's name?'
    → THE KURGAN

    Kurgan — filmning asosiy yovuz
    personaji.

    ⚠ 'the' bilan yoziladi: 'THE Kurgan'.

 5  'What happens when an immortal has his
     head cut off?'
    → THE QUICKENING

    'The Quickening' — o'lgan o'lmasning
    kuchi g'olibga o'tadi.

    ⚠ 'The Lightning' (chaqmoq) va
    'The Hurrying' (shoshilish) — mavjud
    emas, chalg'ituvchi variantlar.


⚠ 2-BAND — ASR QANDAY SANALADI:

  1518-yil → 16-ASR

  ⚠ Asr raqami yil raqamidan BITTA KATTA:
     1518 → 16-asr (1501-1600)
     1986 → 20-asr (1901-2000)
     2026 → 21-asr (2001-2100)

  Sababi: 1-asr 1-yildan 100-yilgacha.


⚠ EGALIK ShAKLI:
  'the Highlander'S name'
  'the Highlander'S teacher'
  'the Black Knight'S name'

  Hammasi BIRLIK → apostrof + s.


DIQQAT — 'AN IMMORTAL':
  'mortal' = o'lik, o'ladigan
  'IMmortal' = O'LMAS

  ⚠ 'im-' — INKOR prefiksi ('m' va 'p'
  oldidan):
     possible → IMpossible
     patient → IMpatient
     polite → IMpolite

  Boshqa harflardan oldin 'in-' yoki 'un-':
     correct → INcorrect
     happy → UNhappy


DIQQAT — 'A HIGHLANDER':
  'the Highlands' = Shotlandiya tog'lari
  'a Highlander' = tog'lik odam

  '-er' — joydan kelib chiqqan odamni
  bildiradi:
     London → a Londoner
     New York → a New Yorker
     village → a villager


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a Highlander = tog'lik
  the Highlands = Shotlandiya tog'lari
  a century   = asr
  immortal    = o'lmas
  a knight    = ritsar
  a sword     = qilich
  to cut off  = kesib tashlamoq

tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'MAC-' — Shotlandiya familiyalarining
tipik boshlanishi ('o'g'li' degani):
MacLeod, MacDonald, MacArthur.

Chalg'ituvchi variantlar ham shotlandcha
ko'rinadi (Mc- bilan), lekin filmdagi
qahramon — CONNOR MACLEOD.

(Filmda 'MacLeod' — o'rtada bosh harf bilan.)

Konnor 1518-yilda tug'ilgan → 16-ASR.

⚠ ASR SANASH: asr raqami yil raqamidan BITTA
KATTA:
  1518 → 16-asr (1501-1600)
  1986 → 20-asr

'The 20th century' — filmning IKKINCHI davri,
lekin u o'shanda tug'ilmagan.

RAMIREZ — Konnorni o'rgatadigan qadimiy
o'lmas.

U unga QILICH bilan jang qilishni o'rgatadi
(2-mashqning b bandi).

⚠ 'Rodriquez' va 'Gonzales' — o'xshash
ispancha familiyalar, chalg'ituvchi
variantlar.

KURGAN — filmning asosiy YOVUZ personaji.

⚠ 'THE' bilan yoziladi: 'the Kurgan'.

'a knight' = ritsar ('k' O'QILMAYDI: /naɪt/).

tasks.whyUz:
'THE QUICKENING' — o'lgan o'lmasning KUCHI
g'olibga o'tadi.

⚠ 'The Lightning' (chaqmoq) va 'The Hurrying'
(shoshilish) — filmda mavjud emas,

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the sentences with words from the list: antique, head, kilts, fight, candle
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (5 ta so'z):
  antique, head, kilts, fight, candle


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  a)  head
  b)  fight
  c)  candle
  d)  kilts
  e)  antique


TO'LIQ GAPLAR:

 a) 'The only way the Highlander can die is
     by having his HEAD cut off.'
    = Tog'lik o'lishining yagona yo'li —
      boshini kesish.

 b) 'Ramirez teaches the Highlander to
     FIGHT with a sword.'
    = Ramirez tog'likka qilich bilan jang
      qilishni o'rgatadi.

 c) 'The Highlander lights a CANDLE on
     Heather's birthday.'
    = Tog'lik Xezerning tug'ilgan kunida
      sham yoqadi.

 d) 'Highlanders wear KILTS.'
    = Tog'liklar kilt kiyadi.

 e) 'The Highlander becomes an ANTIQUE
     dealer in New York.'
    = Tog'lik Nyu-Yorkda antikvariat
      sotuvchisi bo'ladi.


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — SO'Z TURIGA QARANG:

 a  'having his ...... CUT OFF'
    Kesiladigan TANA A'ZOSI → HEAD
    (1-mashqning 5-bandi ham shu haqida)

 b  'teaches the Highlander TO ......'
    'to' dan keyin — FE'L
    'with a sword' bilan → FIGHT

 c  'lights a(n) ......'
    'light' (yoqmoq) bilan keladigan OT
    → CANDLE (sham)
    ⚠ 'light a candle' — turg'un birikma

 d  'Highlanders WEAR ......'
    'wear' (kiymoq) bilan → KIYIM
    → KILTS

 e  'becomes a(n) ...... DEALER'
    'dealer' (sotuvchi) dan oldin —
    NIMA sotadi
    → ANTIQUE (antikvariat)


⚠ 'A(N)' — KITOBNING ISHORASI:

  c va e bandlarida kitob 'a(n)' deb
  yozgan:

     c)  'a CANDLE'    (undosh → a)
     e)  'an ANTIQUE'  (unli → an)

  ⚠ 'antique' /ænˈtiːk/ — 'a' unlisi bilan
  boshlanadi → AN.


⚠ 'A KILT' NIMA:

  'a kilt' = shotland erkaklar yubkasi
  (katak matodan tikilgan an'anaviy kiyim)

  ⚠ Bu — AYOL yubkasi emas! Shotlandiyada
  erkaklar bayram va marosimlarda kiyadi.

  3a-mashqda 'kilts' 16-ASR kiyimi
  bo'limiga tushadi.


⚠ 'ANTIQUE' — SIFAT VA OT:

  'antique' (sifat) = qadimiy, antikvar
     'an antique table' = qadimiy stol
  'antiques' (ot, ko'plikda) = antikvar
     buyumlar
  'an antique dealer' = antikvariat
     sotuvchisi

  ⚠ 'antique' va 'ancient' FARQI:
     antique = qadimiy va QIMMATLI buyum
        (100+ yil)
     ancient = juda qadimiy davr
        ('ancient Egypt')


⚠ 'TEACH SOMEBODY TO DO SOMETHING':

  'Ramirez teaches the Highlander TO
   FIGHT.'

  Qolip: 'teach + KIM + TO + FE'L'

  Shunga o'xshash:
     'ask somebody TO do'
     'tell somebody TO do'
     'want somebody TO do'

  Coursebook 113-bet: 'David asks Sandra TO
  TAKE some pictures.'


⚠ 'THE ONLY WAY ... IS BY + V-ING':

  'The only way he can die IS BY HAVING his
   head cut off.'

  'by + V-ing' = ... yo'li bilan

  Masalan:
     'You can learn English by reading.'


DIQQAT — 'TO LIGHT':
  'to light a candle' = sham yoqmoq
  light → LIT → LIT (noto'g'ri fe'l)

  ⚠ Coursebook 114-bet: 'You mustn't LIGHT
  fires in the forest.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a head      = bosh
  to cut off  = kesib tashlamoq
  to fight    = jang qilmoq
  a sword     = qilich
  a candle    = sham
  to light    = yoqmoq
  a kilt      = kilt (shotland kiyimi)
  antique     = qadimiy, antikvar
  a dealer    = sotuvchi

O'N TO'RT BUYUM — YETTI JUFTLIK:

  cars, swords, CDs, horses, wells,
  guns, bagpipes, fires, central heating,
  suits, taps, cottages, kilts, flats


TO'LIQ TAQSIMOT:

╔═══════════╦═══════════════╦══════════════╗
║ BO'LIM    ║ 16-ASR        ║ 20-ASR       ║
╠═══════════╬═══════════════╬══════════════╣
║ Clothes   ║ kilts         ║ suits        ║
║ Homes     ║ cottages      ║ flats        ║
║ Travel    ║ horses        ║ cars         ║
║ Weapons   ║ swords        ║ guns         ║
║ Music     ║ bagpipes      ║ CDs          ║
║ Heating   ║ fires         ║ central      ║
║           ║               ║ heating      ║
║ Water     ║ wells         ║ taps         ║
╚═══════════╩═══════════════╩══════════════╝


⚠ 7 ta bo'lim × 2 ta davr = 14 ta buyum.
Har buyum FAQAT BITTA katakka tushadi.


HAR JUFTLIK IZOHI:

  KIYIM:
     16-asr — KILTS (shotland an'anaviy
        kiyimi)
     20-asr — SUITS (kostyum)

  UY:
     16-asr — COTTAGES (kichik qishloq
        uyi, toshdan)
     20-asr — FLATS (kvartira, ko'p
        qavatli binoda)
     ⚠ 'a flat' — Britaniya;
       'an apartment' — Amerika.

  TRANSPORT:
     16-asr — HORSES (ot)
     20-asr — CARS (mashina)
     ⚠ Coursebook 113-bet, 5-mashq: ot —
       IBTIDOIY, mashina — ZAMONAVIY.

  QUROL:
     16-asr — SWORDS (qilich)
     20-asr — GUNS (o'q otar qurol)
     ⚠ Filmda o'lmaslar QILICH bilan jang
       qiladi — chunki faqat boshni kesish
       ularni o'ldiradi (2-mashq, a bandi).

  MUSIQA:
     16-asr — BAGPIPES (shotland
        cholg'usi)
     20-asr — CDs (kompakt disk)
     ⚠ 'bagpipes' — DOIM KO'PLIKDA
       ('a bag' = xalta, 'a pipe' = nay).
     ⚠ 'CD' = Compact Disc; ko'pligi 'CDs'
       (apostrofsiz!).

  ISITISh:
     16-asr — FIRES (ochiq olov, kamin)
     20-asr — CENTRAL HEATING (markaziy
        isitish)

  SUV:
     16-asr — WELLS (quduq)
     20-asr — TAPS (jo'mrak)
     ⚠ 'a tap' — Britaniya;
       'a faucet' — Amerika.
     ⚠ 5-nazorat testi, 2-mashq, 8-band:
       'They didn't have RUNNING WATER
        then.' — aynan shu mavzu!


⚠ NEGA BU MASHQ UNIT 9 GA MOS:

  Unit 9 nomi — 'Times Change...'
  (Zamonlar o'zgaradi).

  Unit 9 grammatikasi:
     'There WERE guest houses but there
      WEREN'T any hotels then.'

  Bu mashq aynan shu qurilma uchun
  MATERIAL beradi!


⚠ FILM BILAN BOG'LIQ:

  'Highlander' filmi IKKI DAVRDA parallel
  boradi:
     16-asr Shotlandiyasi
     20-asr Nyu-Yorki

  Konnor ikkalasini ham ko'rgan — u
  o'lmas!


DOIM KO'PLIKDA BO'LADIGAN SO'ZLAR:
  bagpipes (shotland cholg'usi)
  ⚠ Shunga o'xshash: scissors, trousers,
  glasses, jeans.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a kilt      = kilt
  a suit      = kostyum
  a cottage   = qishloq uyi
  a flat      = kvartira (BrE)
  a sword     = qilich
  a gun       = o'q otar qurol
  bagpipes    = volinka (shotland cholg'usi)
  a CD        = kompakt disk
  a fire      = olov, kamin
  central heating = markaziy isitish
  a well      = quduq
  a tap       = jo'mrak (BrE)

exercises.instructionEn: Now write a brief paragraph about life in Scotland in the 16th century.
exercises.instructionUz: Endi 16-asrda Shotlandiyadagi hayot haqida qisqa paragraf yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ BU MAShQ OChIQ JAVOBLI — o'zingiz
yozasiz.

⚠ 3a-mashqdagi jadval — TAYYOR REJA!
Uning 16-asr ustunidagi yetti so'zni
ishlating.


NAMUNA PARAGRAF:

──────────────────────────────────
  'Life in Scotland in the 16th century
   was very different from life today.

   People wore KILTS and lived in small
   COTTAGES. They travelled on HORSES
   because there weren't any cars.

   Soldiers fought with SWORDS — there
   weren't any guns. People played the
   BAGPIPES; there were no CDs or radios.

   Homes were cold, so people made FIRES
   to keep warm. There wasn't any central
   heating. They didn't have taps — they
   got their water from WELLS.

   Life was hard, but people were strong.'
──────────────────────────────────

  Tarjimasi:
  '16-asrda Shotlandiyadagi hayot bugungi
   hayotdan juda farq qilardi.

   Odamlar kilt kiyishardi va kichik
   qishloq uylarida yashashardi. Ular otda
   yurishardi, chunki mashina yo'q edi.

   Askarlar qilich bilan jang qilishardi —
   o'q otar qurol yo'q edi. Odamlar volinka
   chalishardi; kompakt disk ham, radio ham
   yo'q edi.

   Uylar sovuq edi, shuning uchun odamlar
   isinish uchun olov yoqishardi. Markaziy
   isitish yo'q edi. Ularda jo'mrak yo'q
   edi — suvni quduqdan olishardi.

   Hayot og'ir edi, lekin odamlar kuchli
   edi.'


⚠ UNIT 9 GRAMMATIKASI — MAJBURIY:

  Bu paragraf O'TMISh haqida, shuning uchun
  PAST SIMPLE ishlatiladi:

     wore, lived, travelled, fought,
     played, made, got

  ⚠ 'THERE WAS / THERE WERE' qurilmasi:
     'There WEREN'T any cars.'
     'There WASN'T any central heating.'

  ⚠ Inkorda 'ANY':
     'there weren't ANY guns'  ✓
     'there weren't SOME guns' ✗


FOYDALI QOLIPLAR:

  TAQQOSLASh:
     'Life ... was very different FROM life
      today.'
     'People didn't have ..., they had ...
      instead.'

  YO'QLIK:
     'There weren't any ...'
     'They didn't have ...'
     'There was no ...'

  SABAB:
     '..., so ...' (shuning uchun)
     '..., because ...' (chunki)


⚠ NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR (paragrafda kerak
bo'ladi):

  wear → WORE → worn
  fight → FOUGHT → fought
  make → MADE → made
  get → GOT → got
  have → HAD → had
  be → WAS/WERE → been

  (Coursebook 116-bet jadvalidan)


DIQQAT — 'BRIEF':
  'brief' = qisqa
  'a brief paragraph' = qisqa paragraf

  = 'a short paragraph'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  brief       = qisqa
  different from = ... dan farq qiladi
  a soldier   = askar
  to keep warm = isinmoq
  hard        = og'ir, qiyin
  instead     = o'rniga

exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI OChIQ SAVOL:

 1  'Would you like to live forever?
     Why/Why not?'
    = Abadiy yashashni istarmidingiz?
      Nega? / Nega yo'q?

 2  'Do you think life is better now than
     it was 500 years ago? Why/Why not?'
    = Sizningcha, hozirgi hayot 500 yil
      oldingidan yaxshiroqmi? Nega? /
      Nega yo'q?


⚠ BU MAShQ OChIQ JAVOBLI — o'z fikringizni
aytishingiz kerak.


1-SAVOL — NAMUNA JAVOBLAR:

  HA:
     'Yes, I would. I would like to live
      forever because I could see the
      future and learn a lot of things.'

  YO'Q:
     'No, I wouldn't. I wouldn't like to
      live forever because all my friends
      and family would die and I would be
      alone.'

  ⚠ Filmda aynan shu muammo ko'rsatiladi:
  Konnor xotini Xezerning qarib o'lishini
  ko'radi, o'zi esa yosh qoladi.
  (2-mashqning c bandi: 'lights a candle
   on HEATHER'S birthday'.)


2-SAVOL — NAMUNA JAVOBLAR:

  HA (hozir yaxshiroq):
     'Yes, I think life is better now
      because we have central heating,
      running water and cars. Medicine is
      better, too — people live longer.'

  YO'Q:
     'No, I don't think so. Life was
      simpler 500 years ago. There wasn't
      any pollution and people had more
      time for their families.'

  ⚠ 3a-mashqdagi jadval — TAYYOR DALIL!
  Har juftlikni taqqoslash mumkin.


⚠ GRAMMATIKA — 'WOULD LIKE':

  'WOULD you like to ...?' — muloyim savol

  QISQA JAVOBLAR:
     'Yes, I WOULD.'  /  'No, I WOULDN'T.'

  ⚠ 'Yes, I would LIKE.' — chala
  ⚠ 'Yes, I want.' — qo'polroq


⚠ GRAMMATIKA — QIYOSIY DARAJA:

  'life is BETTER NOW THAN it was 500
   years ago'

  good → BETTER → the best

  ⚠ 6-nazorat testi, 2-mashq, 10-band:
  'Your picture is BETTER than Tony's.'

  ⚠ 'THAN' — qiyosiy darajada SHART.


⚠ '500 YEARS AGO':
  'ago' — o'lchovdan KEYIN, GAP OXIRIDA.
  DOIM Past Simple bilan.


FOYDALI SO'ZLAR (2-savol uchun):

  HOZIR YAXShI:
     medicine (tibbiyot), technology,
     comfort (qulaylik), education,
     travel, communication

  OLDIN YAXShI:
     pollution (ifloslanish) — hozir ko'p
     stress — hozir ko'p
     nature (tabiat) — oldin toza
     simple life (oddiy hayot)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  forever     = abadiy
  alone       = yolg'iz
  medicine    = tibbiyot
  pollution   = ifloslanish
  comfort     = qulaylik
  simple      = oddiy
  I don't think so = menimcha unday emas

tasks.en: 1  Would you like to live forever? Why/Why not?
tasks.uz: 1 Abadiy yashashni istarmidingiz? Nega? / Nega yo'q?
tasks.note:
QISQA JAVOB: 'Yes, I WOULD.' / 'No, I
WOULDN'T.'

⚠ Filmda aynan shu muammo: Konnor xotini
Xezerning qarib o'lishini ko'radi, o'zi esa
yosh qoladi.

'forever' = abadiy; 'alone' = yolg'iz.

tasks.en: 2  Do you think life is better now than it was 500 years ago?
tasks.uz: 2 Sizningcha, hozirgi hayot 500 yil oldingidan yaxshiroqmi?
tasks.note:
⚠ QIYOSIY DARAJA: good → BETTER → the best.
'THAN' SHART.

⚠ '500 years AGO' — 'ago' gap oxirida, Past
Simple bilan.

3a-mashqdagi jadval — TAYYOR DALIL: har
juftlikni taqqoslang.

tasks.en: Yes: We have central heating, running water and cars. Medicine is better, too.  /  No: There wasn't any pollution and people had more time.
tasks.uz: Ha: Bizda markaziy isitish, vodoprovod va mashina bor. Tibbiyot ham yaxshiroq. / Yo'q: Ifloslanish yo'q edi va odamlarning vaqti ko'p edi.
tasks.note:
Ikki tomonlama fikr — bahsda foydali.

HOZIR YAXSHI: medicine, technology, comfort.
OLDIN YAXSHI: nature, less pollution, simple
life.

'I don't think so' = menimcha unday emas.

items.base: the only way ... IS BY + V-ING
items.derived: is BY HAVING his head cut off

sentencePatterns.formula: There WEREN'T ANY + [ko'plik].   /   They DIDN'T HAVE + [ot].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There weren't any cars. They didn't have taps.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mashina yo'q edi. Ularda jo'mrak yo'q edi.

sentencePatterns.formula: In the 16th century people [2-SHAKL] ... , but now we [Present Simple] ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: In the 16th century people wore kilts, but now we wear suits.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: 16-asrda odamlar kilt kiyishardi, lekin hozir biz kostyum kiyamiz.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
3a-mashqdagi jadvalning har juftligi shu
qolipga tushadi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Ramirez teaches the Highlander to fight with a sword.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ramirez tog'likka qilich bilan jang qilishni o'rgatadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Shunga o'xshash: ask / tell / want somebody
TO do something.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The only way the Highlander can die is by having his head cut off.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tog'lik o'lishining yagona yo'li — boshini kesish.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'by + V-ing' = ... yo'li bilan.
'You can learn English BY READING.'

sentencePatterns.formula: WOULD you like to ... ?  —  Yes, I WOULD. / No, I WOULDN'T.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Would you like to live forever? — No, I wouldn't.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Qisqa javobda 'would' takrorlanadi.
'Yes, I would like.' — chala.

sentencePatterns.formula: Life is BETTER now THAN it was [vaqt] AGO.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Life is better now than it was 500 years ago.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
good → BETTER → the best.
'THAN' SHART; 'ago' gap oxirida.
